newsitem.title: THAILAND: TPI Polene down on new share issue.
newsitem.headline: TPI Polene down on new share issue.

text.p: Share of Thai cement producer TPI Polene Plc fell in early trade on Monday on concern about a dilution effect after the announcement of its capital increase plan, brokers said.
"The company's new shares are nearly twice the number of existing shares. Investors were worried that the earnings per share will be diluted," said one broker at Nava Finance.
TPI Polene was off 1.50 baht to 39.50 by 0358 GMT with 131,800 shares changing hands.
TPI Polene Plc said on Monday it will issue 260.7 million new shares to raise registered capital to 5.31 billion baht ($204.2 million) from 2.7 billion.
Of the new shares, 253.75 million shares will be offered to existing shareholders through a one-for-one rights issue at 10 baht each, TPI Polene said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The remaining shares will be reserved for the conversion of the company's existing convertible debentures, it said.
